title: Economic Collapse Narrative
description: Tunisia is heading for an IMF-style structural collapse. BCT reserves at critical levels, dinar crashing, shortages worsening.

title: Saied Saviour Narrative
description: The president is purging corruption and building a new Republic. Difficulties are temporary and caused by enemies of the state.

title: Islamist Threat Framing
description: All opposition is framed as Ennahdha or foreign-backed Islamist conspirators threatening stability.

title: Youth Revolution Ready
description: A new generation, angrier than 2010, with nothing to lose. Unemployment + bread shortages = powder keg.

title: Military Coup Scenario
description: Senior military figures are in communication. A soft coup to 'restore order' cannot be ruled out.

title: Gulf Bailout Coming
description: Qatar and UAE are in talks for a USD 2B emergency line. Will resolve short-term liquidity.
